Two-pointer sweep comparing outer to inner. O(n).

For palindrome check str I will compare s[i] with s[n-1-i].

```python
def is_palindrome(s):
    lo, hi = 0, len(s) - 1
    while lo < hi:
        if s[lo] != s[hi]: return False
        lo += 1; hi -= 1
    return True
```
